paletteHue.title: Palette hue
paletteHue.description: Rotates every color in the palette by this many degrees, land, water, roads, and text alike, so the whole map turns together and the hue relationships between families hold. Wraps at 360.

paletteSaturation.title: Palette saturation
paletteSaturation.description: Multiplies the saturation of every color in the palette, so the whole map gains or loses color together. A multiplier holds a neutral color neutral, and 0 takes the map to greyscale.

paletteLightness.title: Palette lightness
paletteLightness.description: Adds this many points to the lightness of every color in the palette, so the whole map lightens or darkens together and the steps between tones hold. The light palette starts near the top of the scale, so most of the travel runs downward: -70 reaches a dark map.

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.description: Base color of the land surface. The warm neutral family derives from it: land tints, building outlines, minor road casings, paths, and path labels.

water.title: Water
water.description: Color of rivers, streams, and canals. Intermittent water derives from it.

vegetation.title: Vegetation
vegetation.description: Color of parks and grass. Woodland derives from it.

road.title: Road
road.description: Fill color of trunk, primary, secondary, and tertiary roads. Their tunnel fills derive from it.

motorway.title: Motorway
motorway.description: Fill color of motorways and motorway links. Every major road casing derives from it.

boundary.title: Boundary
boundary.description: Color of country boundaries. Region boundaries derive from it.

label.title: Label
label.description: Color of place labels below city rank. Halos take maximum contrast against it.

roadScale.title: Road scale
roadScale.description: Multiplies every road width, motorways and every other class alike, so the whole network thickens or thins together while the relative widths between classes hold. Raise it for thicker roads at the same zoom.

labelScale.title: Label scale
labelScale.description: Multiplies every label text size, from country names down to highway shields, so all text grows or shrinks together while the relative sizes between classes hold. Raise it for larger text at the same zoom.
